Definition: Nepheg, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nepheg is one of the sons born to David in Jerusalem, named among his children in the chronicles of the king's house. He is named in Samuel and in both chronicles of the king's house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sons born in Jerusalem are the fruit of the kingdom at rest: David's house grows in the city God chose, and every son is named in the chronicle.
